question_text: A composite rod is formed by connecting two rods A and B as shown in the figure. Longitudinal pulse applied at the free end of the rod A propagates with a speed $v$ respectively. A longitudinal pulse of this wave when it propagates through rod A and B is 420 m s$^{-1}$ and 240 m s$^{-1}$. What is the wavelength of this wave when it propagates through rod A and B respectively. The length of rod A is 2m.
